points.quote: **`IDisposable`:** anything with a `dispose()` method. ... `Event<T>` is a function that returns an `IDisposable` when you subscribe.
**`Disposable`:** a base class that owns a protected `_store`. Subclasses register children with `this._register(x)`, and `dispose()` cleans them up.
**`DisposableStore`:** a collection that disposes everything it holds. ... `toDisposable(fn)` wraps a cleanup callback
**`MutableDisposable`:** holds one replaceable resource. Setting a new value disposes the old one, and disposing the holder disposes the current value.
`ensureNoDisposablesAreLeakedInTestSuite()` in `src/vs/base/test/common/utils.ts` installs a `DisposableTracker` before each test and fails the suite if anything was left undisposed.
